findings.description: Switching from `match` to `fullmatch` breaks existing regex predicates that match only the beginning of an exception message. Preserve `match` while allowing empty patterns.
findings.rationale: With `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` and an exception whose message is "timeout connecting to server", the previous implementation returns true, but `fullmatch` returns false because trailing text remains. The operation now stops retrying and propagates the exception despite satisfying the existing prefix-matching predicate.
